threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'takeaway' instead of 'takeout' and get puzzled by the endless options for vegan options at the pub.
Caught a bloke on the 59 last night trying to impress a girl with his deep knowledge of obscure Brixton history—she looked utterly bewildered.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids using the bus stop as a stage for their impromptu dance-off - that's when I knew this place has its own vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s not uncommon to spot a spontaneous dance party at a U-Bahn stop, fueled by street musicians and good vibes. Just Berlin life!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they can name three taco trucks and have a favorite based on time of day. Tourist just ask for the nearest one.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that stopped mid-route so the driver could give a homeless man some change. No one seemed surprised, just another day in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every corner café is for them, but some locals still play cards in the back, hiding the good conversations from outsiders.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they keep their jackets on while dining outdoors at La Plaça, unaware locals have moved on to enjoying the chill.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still use your phone to navigate; everyone else just knows the secret backstreets and which way the bus actually goes.
Caught a guy holding a bouquet of flowers at 3 AM, chatting up the driver like they were old mates. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids using a bus stop as a skateboard ramp while an elderly man shook his head, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have the best graffiti? It’s like an art gallery underground, changing with the seasons.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's from here by how they navigate the BART delays—locals just roll their eyes and grab a burrito instead of complaining.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing the accordion on the Muni, totally out of tune but somehow lifted the whole mood. That’s the SF spirit, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Gràcia is just another Gaudí spot—missing the true charm of its local artists and hidden squares buzzing with life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they stare at the metro map like it's a treasure map—glancing up at every stop like it's a surprise.
